The evidence supports the claim. The code and notes describe a method that renders a TSDF voxel band as a continuous surface using isotropic Gaussian splats (one per surface voxel). This approach inherently differs from mesh-based extraction (like marching cubes, which is mentioned in the code comments as a separate function `add_mesh_scene`) by providing a differentiable, continuous representation (Gaussians) rather than a discrete mesh. It also differs from raw voxel rendering by smoothing artifacts; the notes explicitly state that the standard deviation is calculated to ensure neighbors overlap into a 'continuous surface', effectively smoothing the discrete grid.
